Representative original invocation text; do not execute these as inversions.
Source revision: 0a32d73a5c4a72be0505a4ed682472e1613e49e9 unless stated.
Paths are relative to this fixture directory and relative output paths use cwd.

Python historical public spelling (current development raises ImportError):
    from openghg_inversions.rhime import run_rhime
    result = run_rhime(config_file="modern.ini")

Candidate current Python spelling (result is InversionOutput):
    from openghg_inversions.rhime import run_standard
    result = run_standard(config_file="modern.ini")

Installed CLI route (run-rhime is a subcommand):
    rhime run-rhime -c modern.ini
    openghg-inversions run-rhime 2020-01-01 2022-02-01 -c modern.ini --output-path flag --kwargs '{"start_date":"2021-01-01","output_path":"json"}'

Ordinary wrapper route (RHIME executor on current development):
    python -m openghg_inversions.hbmcmc.run_hbmcmc -c fixedbasis.ini
    python -m openghg_inversions.hbmcmc.run_hbmcmc -c fixedbasis.ini --kwargs '<contents of explicit-wrapper.json>'

Unsupported true fixedbasis request on current development (argparse rejects):
    python -m openghg_inversions.hbmcmc.run_hbmcmc -c fixedbasis.ini --legacy-fixedbasis
    Refer to the released-version historical fixtures for the true executor.

Batch launch payload (inspection only, never submitted):
    #!/bin/bash
    #SBATCH --job-name=migration-original
    # Environment activation intentionally belongs to the original source environment.
    python -m openghg_inversions.hbmcmc.run_hbmcmc "${START_DATE}" "${END_DATE}" -c "${CONFIG_FILE}" --kwargs '{"nit":7,"burn":2,"nchain":2}'

The finite examples do not establish that arbitrary dynamically assembled Python
kwargs, custom likelihood callables or locally edited batch scripts can be
converted automatically. #948/#950 own that supported-source decision.
